en.name: Soybean sprouts
en.summary: Soybean sprouts are the thick sprouts with a yellow bean head still attached, used in Korean namul and Chinese soups — a different food from thin mung bean sprouts. Kept dry and cold they last 5–10 days, and they must be cooked, never eaten raw.
en.pantry: Soybean sprouts must be kept refrigerated. Sprouts are grown warm and damp, which is also ideal for Salmonella and E. coli, and any warmth at home simply continues those conditions. There is no room-temperature figure here and none should be assumed. Cook soybean sprouts thoroughly rather than eating them raw — that is both a safety point and a culinary one, since raw soybean sprouts are unpleasantly bitter.
en.fridge: Keep them dry and cold in a vented bag or a lidded box at 4 °C (40 °F) or below, where 5–10 days is the working range — a figure borrowed from bean sprouts generally, since no agency publishes a separate one for soybean sprouts. Never store them wet: standing water in the box is what turns a bag of sprouts to slime overnight. Line the box with kitchen paper and change it when it dampens, and pick out any sprouts that have gone brown at the root before they take the rest with them.
en.freezer: There is no freezer timeline for soybean sprouts and freezing them raw is not worth doing. Sprouts are almost entirely water in a very thin structure, and freezing bursts it — what thaws is limp and slippery with none of the snap that is the whole point. Blanched and squeezed dry they can be frozen for later use in a soup or a filling, but no quality window has been published, and buying less is the better answer.
en.thawing: If you have blanched and frozen them, add them to soups or fillings straight from frozen and squeeze the water out first for a filling. Do not thaw raw sprouts and expect to cook them as fresh.
spoilage: A slimy or slippery film on the sprouts, or liquid pooling in the box
Bean heads gone brown, grey or mushy
Roots browned and soft rather than white and crisp
A sour, fermented or musty smell when the bag is opened
tips: Buy sprouts from a chilled cabinet and get them home cold.
Store dry, in a vented box lined with kitchen paper; never in standing water.
Cook them through — raw soybean sprouts are both risky and bitter.
Keep the bean heads on; that is where the flavour is, and they are the reason this sprout is worth cooking properly.

faq.q: How long do soybean sprouts last in the fridge?
faq.a: 5–10 days at 4 °C (40 °F) or below, kept dry in a vented bag or lidded box. That figure is borrowed from bean sprouts generally.

faq.q: Can you eat soybean sprouts raw?
faq.a: No. Sprouts are grown in warm damp conditions that also suit Salmonella and E. coli, so cook them thoroughly. Raw soybean sprouts are also very bitter.
No timeline is published and raw freezing is pointless — the crisp texture is lost entirely. Blanched and squeezed dry they can go into a soup or filling later.

faq.q: Are soybean sprouts the same as bean sprouts?
faq.a: No. Mung bean sprouts are thin with no bean head and cook in seconds; soybean sprouts are thicker, keep a yellow bean head and need real cooking to lose their bitterness.

zh.name: 黃豆芽
zh.summary: 黃豆芽是頂端還帶著黃色豆瓣的粗豆芽，韓式涼拌和中式湯品常用——它和細細的綠豆芽是不同的食材。保持乾燥低溫可放 5～10 天，而且一定要煮熟，絕對不要生吃。
zh.pantry: 黃豆芽必須全程冷藏。豆芽是在溫暖潮濕的環境中培育出來的，而那同樣是沙門氏菌和大腸桿菌最理想的條件；在家裡讓它回溫，等於是把那個條件延續下去。這裡不提供常溫保存天數，也請不要自行推估。黃豆芽務必徹底煮熟再吃——這既是安全考量也是風味考量，因為生的黃豆芽苦得難以入口。
zh.fridge: 請保持乾燥低溫，裝在有透氣孔的袋子或有蓋保鮮盒裡，冷藏於 4°C 以下，5～10 天是工作範圍——這個數字是比照豆芽菜整體而來，因為沒有任何單位為黃豆芽單獨公布數字。絕對不要濕著保存：盒底積水，一整袋豆芽一夜之間就會爛成黏糊。盒子底部鋪廚房紙巾，濕了就換；另外，把根部已經發褐的那幾根挑掉，免得拖累其他。
zh.freezer: 黃豆芽沒有冷凍保存期限，生凍也不值得。豆芽幾乎全是包在極薄結構裡的水，冷凍會把結構撐破——解凍後只剩軟塌滑膩的一團，完全沒有那份脆度，而脆度正是它的全部。汆燙後擠乾倒是可以冷凍，之後拿來煮湯或做餡，但沒有公布的品質期限；買少一點才是更好的答案。
zh.thawing: 如果是汆燙後冷凍的，請不解凍直接下湯；要做餡的話先把水擠乾。不要解凍生豆芽還當成新鮮的來炒。
spoilage: 豆芽表面出現黏滑的薄膜，或盒底積出一灘水
根部由白脆轉為褐色軟爛
打開袋子聞到酸味、發酵味或霉味
tips: 在冷藏櫃購買，並全程保冷帶回家。
保持乾燥，用鋪了廚房紙巾的透氣盒保存；絕對不要泡在水裡。
務必煮熟——生黃豆芽既有風險也很苦。
豆瓣不要摘掉，風味就在那裡，也正是這種豆芽值得好好煮的原因。

faq.q: 黃豆芽放冰箱可以放多久？
faq.a: 4°C 以下冷藏、保持乾燥裝在透氣袋或有蓋盒裡，5～10 天。這個數字是比照豆芽菜整體而來。
不行。豆芽是在溫暖潮濕的環境培育的，那也是沙門氏菌和大腸桿菌喜歡的條件，請徹底煮熟。而且生的黃豆芽非常苦。
沒有公布的期限，生凍也沒有意義——脆度會完全消失。汆燙擠乾後倒是可以冷凍，之後拿去煮湯或做餡。

faq.q: 黃豆芽和綠豆芽一樣嗎？
faq.a: 不一樣。綠豆芽細、沒有豆瓣，幾秒就熟；黃豆芽粗、帶著黃色豆瓣，而且要確實煮透才會去掉苦味。
